recipes.title: Chickpea Curry
recipes.description: Hearty chickpea curry simmered with spices and coconut milk.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add curry powder, chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer 10–15 minutes.
Season and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Dhal
recipes.description: Creamy spiced red lentils, comforting and quick to make.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, add curry powder then lentils and water; simmer until soft.
Adjust seasoning and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Eggplant Curry
recipes.description: Cubed eggplant simmered in a spiced tomato-coconut sauce.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, add eggplant and spices, pour coconut milk and simmer until tender.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Red Beans and Rice
recipes.description: Comforting rice cooked with flavored red beans and aromatics.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, add beans and rice and cook with water until rice is tender.
Season to taste and serve.

recipes.title: Rice and Beans
recipes.description: Simple staple of rice served with seasoned beans.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, add beans and rice and cook with water until rice is done.
Season and serve.

recipes.title: Vegetable Paella (Batch 4)
recipes.description: Saffron and paprika flavored rice with mixed vegetables.
steps: Sauté vegetables, add rice and paprika, pour broth and simmer until rice absorbs liquid.
Let rest briefly and serve.

recipes.title: Baked Falafel Bowl
recipes.description: Oven-baked falafel served with rice, hummus, and salad for a balanced bowl.
steps: Assemble bowls with rice, falafel, hummus, and chopped vegetables and drizzle with tahini.

recipes.title: Baked Ricotta Toast
recipes.description: Toasted bread topped with creamy ricotta and fresh tomatoes.
steps: Toast bread, spread ricotta, top with tomato slices, drizzle oil and season.

recipes.title: Baked Oatmeal
recipes.description: Comforting baked oat dish with fruit and spices, great for meal prep.
steps: Mix all ingredients, pour into a baking dish and bake at 180°C/350°F for 25–30 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Coconut Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes with coconut milk for a tropical twist.
steps: Mix wet and dry ingredients separately, combine to form batter, cook pancakes on a hot skillet until golden.

recipes.title: Baked Potatoes with Cheese
recipes.description: Crispy-skinned baked potatoes topped with cheese, butter and sour cream.
steps: Bake potatoes at 200°C/400°F for 45–60 minutes until tender, split open and top with butter, cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Baked Apples with Cinnamon
recipes.description: Apples cored and filled with brown sugar and cinnamon then baked until tender.
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C/350°F.
Fill apples with sugar and cinnamon, dot with butter and bake 25–30 minutes until soft.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice Pudding
recipes.description: Creamy rice pudding simmered in coconut milk and lightly sweetened.
steps: Combine rice, coconut milk, water and sugar, simmer until rice is tender and mixture is creamy.

recipes.title: Mango Smoothie
recipes.description: Refreshing mango and banana smoothie blended with plant milk.
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Miso Soup
recipes.description: Light umami-rich soup with miso paste, tofu and seaweed.
steps: Heat dashi but do not boil, dissolve miso in a little warm liquid then stir back in.
Add tofu and wakame to warm broth and serve garnished with scallion.

recipes.title: Soba Noodle Salad
recipes.description: Cool soba noodles tossed with cucumber, carrot and a sesame-soy dressing.
steps: Cook noodles, rinse under cold water and toss with vegetables and dressing; chill before serving.
